messages:
sam: Product wants a tiny "breadcrumb" inside the console card whenever an automatic fallback happens so PMs can quickly see 'what happened' without opening audit logs. thoughts?
lia: Breadcrumb vs audit: breadcrumbs = ultra-compact meta (no prompt), audits = full payload sampled. keep breadcrumbs readable.
ravi: telemetry: make breadcrumbs fixed schema with 6 fields. audits stay sampled to control cost.
sam: proposed breadcrumb fields: timestamp, policy_short, reason_label, model_from, model_to, debug_id. clicking the breadcrumb should try to open the full audit if available.
elaine: UX: inline single line + hover expand for more labels. severity badge (red/yellow/green) would help triage.
lia: severity mapping: red = error-triggered fallback, yellow = latency-triggered, green = soft routing fallback. labels must be PM-friendly e.g. "Errored -> fallback" or "Slow primary -> fallback".
ravi: backend: two-write path. 1) synchronous breadcrumb write (tiny, <200 bytes) for every fallback. 2) async full audit write only when sample bit set. store full audit in cold store with TTL.
sam: retention thoughts: breadcrumbs 14d by default, org-configurable up to 30d. audits: 14d self-serve, 90d enterprise.
elaine: compliance: strip PII, no prompt text, only anonymized flags and ids. must run through compliance checklist.
ravi: implementer note: include a redaction token on write server-side and enforce allowlist. also batch breadcrumbs per-region (100ms window) to reduce write pressure.
sam: search/filtering: PMs want to filter by policy and reason. index on (org, policy_short, reason_label, ts).
ops-bot: incident-bot: previous trial showed adding human-friendly labels lowered on-call wakeups by ~38% week-over-week.
lia: UI copy variants for A/B: A) "Auto-fallback: Slow primary model" B) "Rerouted to fallback (primary slow)". test for support ping reduction.
elaine: expanded view should show operator CTAs: Retry, Pin primary, Open rollback. clicking "view audit" requires audit-read perm.
ravi: perf estimate: at 5M fallbacks/day breadcrumbs ~60MB/day. acceptable for now; we'll monitor.
sam: decision: implement breadcrumbs (sync tiny row) + sampled audits; org-level retention config; UI shows short label + why link + operator CTAs; audit-read required to view full audit. owners: ravi -> writer + batching spec (Wed), elaine -> mocks (Tue), lia -> compliance checklist (Thu), sam -> rollout flags + A/B (Fri).
ops-bot: note logged: decision recorded in #eng-platform 1764401234.
sam: thanks team. closing thread unless objections. :sparkles:
